keyPoints.en: Before Western rule, Sarawak was part of the Brunei Sultanate; Sabah was under Brunei (west and north) and Sulu (east).
keyPoints.bm: Sebelum pemerintahan Barat, Sarawak sebahagian daripada Kesultanan Brunei; Sabah di bawah Brunei (barat dan utara) dan Sulu (timur).

keyPoints.en: Communities were led through tribal systems — e.g. the tuai rumah of an Iban longhouse.
keyPoints.bm: Masyarakat dipimpin melalui sistem kesukuan — cth. tuai rumah bagi rumah panjang Iban.

keyPoints.en: Brunei governed through Pengiran and Malay Datu; in Sabah there were also independent local chiefs.
keyPoints.bm: Brunei memerintah melalui Pengiran dan Datu Melayu; di Sabah terdapat juga ketua tempatan yang bebas.

meaning.en: Malay Datu (e.g. Datu Patinggi, Datu Bandar, Datu Temenggung) who ran Sarawak's Malay community.
meaning.bm: Datu Melayu (cth. Datu Patinggi, Datu Bandar, Datu Temenggung) yang mentadbir masyarakat Melayu Sarawak.

meaning.en: A local leader in Sabah who ruled his area without being appointed by a sultan.
meaning.bm: Pemimpin tempatan di Sabah yang memerintah kawasannya tanpa dilantik sultan.

points.en: Sarawak: Iban, Bidayuh, Melanau and others led by longhouse and village heads, guided by adat.
points.bm: Sarawak: Iban, Bidayuh, Melanau dan lain-lain dipimpin ketua rumah panjang dan kampung, berpandukan adat.

points.en: Sabah: Kadazandusun, Murut, Bajau and others led by village chiefs.
points.bm: Sabah: Kadazandusun, Murut, Bajau dan lain-lain dipimpin ketua kampung.

points.en: A. Sarawak: Brunei appointed governors (e.g. Pengiran Indera Mahkota) to rule on its behalf.
points.bm: A. Sarawak: Brunei melantik pembesar (cth. Pengiran Indera Mahkota) untuk memerintah bagi pihaknya.

points.en: B. Datu system in Sarawak: Malay Datu managed local affairs.
points.bm: B. Sistem Kedatuan di Sarawak: Datu Melayu menguruskan hal ehwal setempat.

points.en: C. Sabah: Brunei and Sulu appointed chiefs to collect taxes.
points.bm: C. Sabah: Brunei dan Sulu melantik pembesar untuk memungut cukai.

points.en: D. Independent chiefs in Sabah ruled some areas on their own.
points.bm: D. Ketua bebas di Sabah memerintah sesetengah kawasan secara sendiri.

question.en: Who controlled Sarawak and Sabah before the Western powers came?
question.bm: Siapakah yang menguasai Sarawak dan Sabah sebelum kedatangan kuasa Barat?

answer.en: Sarawak: the Brunei Sultanate. Sabah: Brunei in the west and north, Sulu in the east, plus independent local chiefs.
answer.bm: Sarawak: Kesultanan Brunei. Sabah: Brunei di barat dan utara, Sulu di timur, serta ketua tempatan yang bebas.

keyPoints.en: When James Brooke arrived (1839), local Malays and Bidayuh were rebelling against the Brunei governor Pengiran Indera Mahkota.
keyPoints.bm: Ketika James Brooke tiba (1839), orang Melayu dan Bidayuh tempatan sedang memberontak terhadap pembesar Brunei, Pengiran Indera Mahkota.

keyPoints.en: Brooke helped Pengiran Muda Hashim end the revolt and was made Rajah of Sarawak in 1841.
keyPoints.bm: Brooke membantu Pengiran Muda Hashim menamatkan pemberontakan dan dilantik sebagai Rajah Sarawak pada 1841.

keyPoints.en: He gained power through negotiation, threats, treaties and military force.
keyPoints.bm: Beliau mendapat kuasa melalui rundingan, ugutan, perjanjian dan kekuatan tentera.

keyPoints.en: The Brooke dynasty expanded Sarawak by taking more land from Brunei until 1905.
keyPoints.bm: Dinasti Brooke meluaskan Sarawak dengan mengambil lebih banyak wilayah daripada Brunei hingga 1905.

meaning.en: "White Rajah" — the Brooke rulers of Sarawak (1841–1946).
James Brooke (1841–1868), Charles Brooke (1868–1917), Charles Vyner Brooke (1917–1946).
meaning.bm: James Brooke (1841–1868), Charles Brooke (1868–1917), Charles Vyner Brooke (1917–1946).

points.en: Negotiation: offered help to Pengiran Muda Hashim in return for Sarawak.
points.bm: Rundingan: menawarkan bantuan kepada Pengiran Muda Hashim sebagai balasan Sarawak.

points.en: Threats: pointed the guns of his ship at Brunei leaders to force them to keep their promise.
points.bm: Ugutan: menghalakan meriam kapalnya ke arah pembesar Brunei untuk memaksa mereka menunaikan janji.

points.en: Treaties: the Sultan of Brunei confirmed him as Rajah (1842).
points.bm: Perjanjian: Sultan Brunei mengesahkan beliau sebagai Rajah (1842).

points.en: Military: with the British navy he attacked groups he called pirates.
points.bm: Ketenteraan: bersama tentera laut British beliau menyerang kumpulan yang dianggapnya lanun.

points.en: Allied with Malay Datu and some Iban groups; built forts along the rivers.
points.bm: Bersekutu dengan Datu Melayu dan sesetengah kumpulan Iban; membina kubu di sepanjang sungai.

points.en: Mukah and Bintulu (1861), Baram (1882), Trusan (1885), Limbang (1890), Lawas (1905).
points.bm: Mukah dan Bintulu (1861), Baram (1882), Trusan (1885), Limbang (1890), Lawas (1905).

points.en: 1888: Sarawak became a British protectorate.
points.bm: 1888: Sarawak menjadi negeri naungan British.

event.en: Lawas added — the last area taken from Brunei.
event.bm: Lawas ditambah — kawasan terakhir diambil daripada Brunei.

alt.en: Sir James Brooke, first White Rajah of Sarawak (portrait by Francis Grant, 1847).
alt.bm: Sir James Brooke, Rajah Putih pertama Sarawak (potret oleh Francis Grant, 1847).

caption.en: Sir James Brooke, first White Rajah of Sarawak (portrait by Francis Grant, 1847).
caption.bm: Sir James Brooke, Rajah Putih pertama Sarawak (potret oleh Francis Grant, 1847).

question.en: Why was Brunei unable to stop the Brookes from taking its territory?
question.bm: Mengapakah Brunei tidak dapat menghalang Brooke mengambil wilayahnya?

answer.en: Brunei was weakened by internal conflicts and had little military strength, while the Brookes had the support of British warships.
answer.bm: Brunei lemah akibat konflik dalaman dan kekuatan tentera yang terhad, manakala Brooke mendapat sokongan kapal perang British.

keyPoints.en: Sabah attracted foreign investors because of its strategic position and economic wealth.
keyPoints.bm: Sabah menarik pemodal asing kerana kedudukan strategik dan kekayaan ekonominya.

keyPoints.en: Early British footholds: Balambangan Island (1773) and Labuan (1846).
keyPoints.bm: Pertapakan awal British: Pulau Balambangan (1773) dan Labuan (1846).

keyPoints.en: Baron von Overbeck and Alfred Dent obtained leases from Brunei and Sulu (1877–1878).
keyPoints.bm: Baron von Overbeck dan Alfred Dent mendapat pajakan daripada Brunei dan Sulu (1877–1878).

keyPoints.en: The British North Borneo Company (BNBC) received a royal charter in 1881 and ruled Sabah until 1946.
keyPoints.bm: Syarikat Borneo Utara British (SBUB) menerima piagam diraja pada 1881 dan memerintah Sabah hingga 1946.

meaning.en: Permission from the British Crown for a company to govern a territory.
meaning.bm: Kebenaran Kerajaan British kepada syarikat untuk memerintah sesuatu wilayah.

meaning.en: Island off northern Sabah where the EIC set up a trading post in 1773.
meaning.bm: Pulau di utara Sabah tempat SHTI membuka pusat perdagangan pada 1773.

meaning.en: Island ceded by Brunei to Britain in 1846; a coaling station and colony.
meaning.bm: Pulau yang diserahkan Brunei kepada British pada 1846; stesen arang batu dan tanah jajahan.

points.en: Balambangan: EIC trading post (1773), attacked by the Sulu and abandoned.
points.bm: Balambangan: pusat perdagangan SHTI (1773), diserang orang Sulu dan ditinggalkan.

points.en: Labuan: ceded to Britain in 1846 and made a Crown colony in 1848.
points.bm: Labuan: diserahkan kepada British pada 1846 dan dijadikan tanah jajahan mahkota pada 1848.

points.en: An American, Charles Lee Moses, first leased land from Brunei (1865); his rights passed to Overbeck.
points.bm: Seorang warga Amerika, Charles Lee Moses, mula-mula memajak tanah daripada Brunei (1865); haknya berpindah kepada Overbeck.

points.en: Overbeck and Dent got leases from the Sultans of Brunei (1877) and Sulu (1878).
points.bm: Overbeck dan Dent mendapat pajakan daripada Sultan Brunei (1877) dan Sultan Sulu (1878).

points.en: Dent formed a company that received the royal charter on 1 November 1881.
points.bm: Dent menubuhkan syarikat yang menerima piagam diraja pada 1 November 1881.

points.en: The company gained more areas from Brunei in the 1880s–1900s; Sabah became a British protectorate in 1888.
points.bm: Syarikat mendapat lebih banyak kawasan daripada Brunei pada 1880-an hingga 1900-an; Sabah menjadi negeri naungan British pada 1888.

question.en: What was the main aim of the British North Borneo Company?
question.bm: Apakah matlamat utama Syarikat Borneo Utara British?

answer.en: To make profit for its shareholders from Sabah's land and resources.
answer.bm: Untuk mendapatkan keuntungan bagi pemegang saham daripada tanah dan sumber Sabah.

keyPoints.en: Western rule in Sarawak (Brookes) and Sabah (BNBC) was strengthened in five ways.
keyPoints.bm: Pentadbiran Barat di Sarawak (Brooke) dan Sabah (SBUB) dimantapkan melalui lima cara.

keyPoints.en: Division of territory, keeping local chiefs, a hierarchy of officials, administration by ethnic group, and new laws.
keyPoints.bm: Pembahagian wilayah, pengekalan pembesar tempatan, pentadbiran berhierarki, pentadbiran berasaskan kaum, dan perundangan.

meaning.en: Administrative area in Sarawak headed by a Resident.
meaning.bm: Kawasan pentadbiran di Sarawak yang diketuai Residen.

meaning.en: Administrative area in Sabah headed by a Resident.
meaning.bm: Kawasan pentadbiran di Sabah yang diketuai Residen.

meaning.en: Sarawak's state council, first held in 1867.
meaning.bm: Majlis negeri Sarawak, pertama kali bersidang pada 1867.

points.en: Sarawak: Divisions under Residents, then districts under District Officers.
points.bm: Sarawak: Bahagian di bawah Residen, kemudian daerah di bawah Pegawai Daerah.

points.en: Sabah: Residencies (e.g. West Coast, East Coast) and districts.
points.bm: Sabah: Residensi (cth. Pantai Barat, Pantai Timur) dan daerah.

points.en: Sarawak: Malay Datu, Iban penghulu and Chinese Kapitan helped rule.
points.bm: Sarawak: Datu Melayu, penghulu Iban dan Kapitan Cina membantu pentadbiran.

points.en: Sabah: native chiefs and village headmen were used to keep order and collect taxes.
points.bm: Sabah: ketua anak negeri dan ketua kampung digunakan untuk menjaga keamanan dan memungut cukai.

points.en: Sarawak: Rajah → Supreme Council (1855) and Council Negri (1867) → Residents → District Officers → local chiefs.
points.bm: Sarawak: Rajah → Majlis Tertinggi (1855) dan Majlis Negeri (1867) → Residen → Pegawai Daerah → pembesar tempatan.

points.en: Sabah: Court of Directors (London) → Governor → Residents → District Officers → native chiefs.
points.bm: Sabah: Lembaga Pengarah (London) → Gabenor → Residen → Pegawai Daerah → ketua anak negeri.

points.en: Each community was managed through its own leaders and given different roles (e.g. Malays in administration, Chinese in trade and farming).
points.bm: Setiap kaum diuruskan melalui pemimpin sendiri dan diberi peranan berbeza (cth. Melayu dalam pentadbiran, Cina dalam perdagangan dan pertanian).

points.en: Western laws were introduced, while native customary law (adat) and native courts continued for local matters.
points.bm: Undang-undang Barat diperkenalkan, sementara undang-undang adat dan mahkamah anak negeri diteruskan untuk hal tempatan.

question.en: Compare the rulers of Sarawak and Sabah under Western administration.
question.bm: Bandingkan pemerintah Sarawak dan Sabah di bawah pentadbiran Barat.

answer.en: Sarawak was ruled by a family — the Brooke Rajahs; Sabah was ruled by a company — the British North Borneo Company, run from London for profit.
answer.bm: Sarawak diperintah sebuah keluarga — Rajah Brooke; Sabah diperintah sebuah syarikat — Syarikat Borneo Utara British, ditadbir dari London untuk keuntungan.
